subject: Arte
description_pt: Pesquisar e analisar diferentes formas de expressão, representação e encenação da dança, reconhecendo e apreciando composições de dança de artistas e grupos brasileiros e estrangeiros de diferentes épocas.

components.description_pt: Pesquisar diferentes formas de expressão e representação na dança em diversos períodos e culturas
components.description_en: Research different forms of expression and representation in dance across periods and cultures

components.description_pt: Analisar elementos de encenação em composições de dança de artistas brasileiros e internacionais
components.description_en: Analyze staging elements in dance compositions by Brazilian and international artists
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how a live or recorded performance interprets and alters elements of a written text

components.description_pt: Reconhecer composições de dança de artistas e grupos brasileiros de diferentes períodos históricos
components.description_en: Recognize dance compositions by Brazilian artists and groups from different historical periods
components.cc_component_description: Compare the treatment of similar themes across stories or myths from different cultures

cc_matches.description: Compare and contrast the treatment of similar themes and topics (e.g., opposition of good and evil) and patterns of events (e.g., the quest) in stories, myths, and traditional literature from different cultures.

Compare and contrast the experience of reading a story, drama, or poem to listening to or viewing an audio, video, or live version of the text, including contrasting what they "see" and "hear" when reading the text to what they perceive when they listen or watch.
